new_articles.title: SK Hynix shares soar over 8% as profit beats, chipmaker to return $25 billion to investors
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'SK Hynix shares soar over 8% as profit beats, chipmaker to return $25 billion to investors'이다. Shares of South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix soared over 8% on Wednesday as third-quarter profit sharply beats estimates. SK Hynix shares rose more than 8%, outperforming the Kospi's 6 In the earnings call, SK Hynix CEO Kwak Noh-Jung cited financial market volatility and a correction in semiconductor stocks as the main reasons to halt its review of potential pre-IPO fundraising and IPO options for its U Kwak Noh-Jung CEO, SK Hynix The company had said it would continue to assess investment timing, scale and financing options to support Solidigm's growth and enhance shareholder value SK Hynix will also buyback 20 trillion won in shares, half of which will be cancelled this year, after completing its previously announced 40 trillion won shares buyback last week — which will be cancelled shortly — as mentioned in the earnings call Memory production boost SK Hynix expects HBM4 to surpass HBM3E in both shipments and revenue in the fourth quarter, as it ramps up production at its M15X facility in Cheongju, South Korea. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.

new_articles.title: AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%
new_articles.summary: SK hynix 관련 기사다. 기사 제목은 'AI chip giant SK hynix says quarterly operating profit soars 630%'이다. SEOUL - South Korean chip giant SK hynix said Wednesday its third-quarter operating profit soared 632 percent on-year, largely driven by the artificial intelligence industry's explosive demand for its advanced memory chips. "SK hynix analyzed that a virtuous cycle has taken hold in which AI-driven productivity gains and new revenue generation in areas such as software development, customer service, and search lead to greater AI adoption," the chipmaker said in a statement SK hynix is a specialist supplier of high-bandwidth memory chips to US industry behemoth Nvidia, and a pillar of South Korea's tech-led economy SK hynix announced an additional plan to return 60 trillion won to shareholders on Wednesday, following the completion of a 40 trillion-won shareholder return programme "The company's stock has fallen nearly 60 percent from its peak (in June), and I think that is the main reason the company needs to focus on winning back shareholders", Kim Dae-jong, a professor of business administration at Sejong University, told AFP " KEYWORDS Sk hynix Ai memory chips High-bandwidth memory Semiconductor industry Dram market Nand flash Nvidia supply chain RECOMMENDED New Zealand ex-PM Ardern to teach leadership in Sydney Brazilian lawmaker Andre Janones, Lula's social media 'general' $1m bounties, dawn arrests: Trump presses voter fraud campaign Japan sets 'second capital' criteria, 4 prefectures qualify Netanyahu, rivals trade attacks over Iran as clock counts down to Israel vote TRENDING Sign in or create an account to save this story to your Saved Stories. 이 기사는 해당 기업과 연결된 해외 보도를 바탕으로 정리했다.
